title: CipherMind
description:
Explore mysterious architectural spaces with oppressive, liminal atmospheres.

Complete mini-game tasks to uncover fragmented clues about other players’ identities.

Access system terminals to retrieve vague intel about other players’ identities.

Make choices based on clues to speculate about your own or others’ true identities: Who are you? Who are they?

If you can successfully identify someone, you can eliminate them, but stay sharp: you might be next.
description_short: 8 test subjects are trapped in a sealed building, controlled by a mysterious system. Each has a hidden codename that determines both their win condition and threat level. Complete tasks to gain clues and eliminate others by deducing their codename. Uncover your own, or survive to the end to escape.
